title: Term Significance
description: Essential Criteria - Identify the physical significance of each term in the Hamiltonian.

title: Dominant Term
description: Essential Criteria - Correctly state which term dominates the interaction with the external field.

title: Eigenstate Verification
description: Important Criteria - Show that (1, +1) is an eigenstate of H and derive its eigenvalue.

title: Decay Observation
description: Important Criteria - Describe how the decay can be detected through the transition to the (0, 0) state.

title: Eigenvalue Calculation
description: Optional Criteria - Provide a clear calculation of the eigenvalue for the (1, +1) state.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Watch for sign mistakes or incorrect identification of dominant terms.
